displayIdentity.body: Paul appeals as a father and sends Timothy. I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children. What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?
displayIdentity.title: Paul appeals as a father and sends Timothy
